# SCI-POINT To Pointing-Support Envelope

Identity: `SCI-POINT_TO_POINTING-SUPPORT v0.1/r0.3`

POINT may publish one immutable per-array fit identity, producer/component
states, exact parent/method/source/coordinate identities, source association,
measured displacement and its sign in the declared basis when available,
uncertainty components, support, diagnostics, and named-use input facts.

The pointing-support producer exclusively owns partial-member admission,
cross-array aggregation, members, weights, dependence/covariance,
measurement-to-correction sign, telescope user/paddle-offset composition,
selection, native validity/support, correction-record publication, and its
displacement-admission profile. It must preserve the exact POINT member and
policy/evaluation provenance.

POINT publishes no aggregate, correction candidate, selection, or whole-
observation success. AST remains the correction-application owner.

A diagnostic-display action in a separate telescope-QC use cannot rescue an
ineligible or decision-unavailable pointing-correction use.
